body:
Hi folks, wondering if there are any plans to add top-level dtypes for MX (https://www.opencompute.org/documents/ocp-microscaling-formats-mx-v1-0-spec-final-pdf) to triton, specifically e8m0 and fp4x2? I saw that the new Blackwell tutorial is using `uint8` for these.
 
We recently added `torch.float8_e8m0fnu` to PyTorch (https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch/pull/147466), and are planning to add fp4 soon (https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch/issues/146414).  We are also thinking about a triton integration via torchinductor, and wanted to ask about your plans for representing these dtypes in triton.
title: Microscaling dtypes in triton?
